change: Opt-in --handoff orchestration for one completed Hiring Signals run
scope: Local sample helper and documentation only

checks: Default exporter stdout and two-command behavior unchanged
Existing raw/handoff directories and dangling symlinks stop before authentication
Current-clock fresh research classification and private 700/600 exclusive commits
Stale and failed-quality held-only diagnostics return exit 3
Fresh valid empty snapshot returns exit 0; stale empty returns exit 3
Changed source hashes and invalid completion markers stop before classification
Malformed quality input and source symlinks fail without a new handoff
Missing, extra or symlink render artifacts cannot be committed
Reflected credential bytes in paths or artifacts cannot be committed
Renderer or commit failure uses fixed scrubbed output and preserves raw export
Concurrent empty handoff target is preserved by exclusive native commit

contract.destinations: Separate new private raw RUN_ID and sibling RUN_ID-handoff directories

exitStatuses.0: Research-ready or fresh valid empty snapshot
exitStatuses.2: Handoff processing failure; complete raw export retained
exitStatuses.3: Held-only or held empty diagnostic handoff; complete raw export retained

limits: Offline orchestration tests do not demonstrate live API compatibility or customer adoption.
Research-ready rows are complete-scan source observations, not current application-route checks or permission to publish.
Path guards require a controlled non-symlink parent outside Git; they do not secure an adversarially replaced ancestor.
Native exclusive commit and POSIX private modes were exercised on macOS; Linux was not independently executed here.
Raw export and handoff are separate commits. A failed handoff preserves a successful raw export.
File hashes support integrity but do not attest arbitrary files as cloud originals.
